verdict.rationale: Evidence shows generic API/webhooks/app-directory integrations and one-way task creation from other tools, but nothing documents a specific bi-directional sync with a code repository's issue tracker (e.g., GitHub/GitLab issues) that avoids duplicate data entry. missing for 10: any first-party GitHub/GitLab issue-sync integration doc, evidence of two-way field/status sync, hands-on confirmation of avoiding data duplication.
